name: 7 Wonders

categories.label: Military
categories.help: Conflict tokens won or lost at the end of each age (defeats are negative).

categories.label: Coins
categories.help: One point for every full set of three coins in your treasury.

categories.label: Wonder
categories.help: Points from the stages of your wonder you have built.

categories.label: Civilian buildings
categories.help: Points printed on your blue cards.

categories.label: Commercial buildings
categories.help: Points from your yellow cards that pay at the end.

categories.label: Guilds
categories.help: Points from your purple guild cards.

categories.label: Science
categories.help: For each symbol type, its count squared, plus 7 for every complete set of all three.

categories.label: Coins left over
categories.help: Total coins in your treasury; the most wins a tie.

notes: Military scores once per age, so it is the only per-round category. Base game only. Category list recalled from the publisher rulebook and not yet re-checked against the printed copy (see source.checked_against_rulebook).
